question: Identify the LAM customer who used EUR and had the highest consumption in October 2013. For this customer, compute their gas consumption decrease rate from 2012 to 2013, defined as (consumption_2012 − consumption_2013) / consumption_2012.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
      AND T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND T2."XCL_020" = '201310'
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS total_2012
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_001" = (SELECT customer_id FROM top_customer)
      AND T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%'
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS total_2013
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_001" = (SELECT customer_id FROM top_customer)
      AND T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%'
)
SELECT CAST((c2012.total_2012 - c2013.total_2013) AS REAL) / c2012.total_2012 AS decrease_rate
FROM consumption_2012 AS c2012
CROSS JOIN consumption_2013 AS c2013
